True def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = next(r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 2 for v in row))
    top = next(r for r in range(divider) if any(v != 0 for v in grid[r]))
    bottom = next(r for r in range(divider + 1, len(grid)) if any(v != 0 for v in grid[r]))
    color = next(v for v in grid[top] if v not in (0, 2))
    columns = [c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if grid[top][c] == color and grid[bottom][c] == color]
    for r in range(top + 1, divider):
        for c in columns:
            out[r][c] = 4
    return out
